q1_issues.issue: `(Future sk_arrive_1)` is unlicensed: the futurate rule requires either a calendar time placeable after a supplied TODAY or a lexically future adjunct, and a bare "on Thursday" with no TODAY is neither, so the parse should carry no tense atom at all.

notes: The singular collective "a delegation" correctly gets one plain event with the group as Agent, no GroupOf and no distribution rule; the structured Time term is well formed.
